newsitem.title: USA: Alfin to meet Amex on stock's eligibility.
newsitem.headline: Alfin to meet Amex on stock's eligibility.

text.p: Alfin Inc said Monday it was scheduled to meet with officials at the American Stock Exchange to discuss the continued listing eligibility of its stock.
"Based upon its current financial position there can be no assurance as to the results of these discussions," it said in a statement.
The company said it had no bank debt and has consolidated its staff and offices.

Last month, it sold its New Jersey distribution, warehousing and administration facility. It then consolidated its administrative staff offices and customer service center at its head offices in New York.
Alfin, maker and distributor of Adrien Arpel cosmetics, has also entered the mail order business.
Its stock closed at 11/16 on Friday. It had yet to trade early Monday.
